# Sources of the test fixtures

## `weather/USA_IL_Chicago-OHare.Intl.AP.725300_TMY3.epw`

Chicago O'Hare International Airport, TMY3 (WMO 725300), copied unchanged from the
`WeatherData/` folder of the EnergyPlus 24.2.0 installation. The data derive from the
U.S. Department of Energy / NREL TMY3 data set (public domain) and are distributed with
EnergyPlus under its BSD-3-Clause-style licence (`LICENSE.txt` of the installation).
The design days in the models come from the station's `.ddy` file in the same folder
(ASHRAE 2009 99.6 % heating and 0.4 % cooling conditions).

## `models/*.idf` and `models/*.sql`

Generated by `regenerate.py` (spec 002, task T028); do not edit by hand. The script builds
each model in code with idfkit, writes it as an EnergyPlus 24.2 IDF, runs one annual
weather-file run period with EnergyPlus 24.2.0 (hourly reporting, 4 timesteps per hour,
design days used for sizing only) and keeps a cut-down copy of the SQLite output:

- tables: `Simulations`, `EnvironmentPeriods`, `Time`, `Zones`, `ZoneLists`, `ZoneGroups`,
  `Surfaces`, `Constructions`, `ConstructionLayers`, `Materials`, `Schedules`, the
  `Nominal*` tables, `ReportDataDictionary`, `ReportData`, `TabularData`, `Strings`,
  `StringTypes`, `Errors` (and the `TabularDataWithStrings` view);
- tabular reports: Annual Building Utility Performance Summary, Envelope Summary,
  Equipment Summary, Input Verification and Results Summary, Lighting Summary;
- report variables and meters: only the R2 items of
  `specs/002-reduce-to-sbem/contracts/results-requirements.md` that apply to the model.

Regenerate with `uv run python tests/fixtures/regenerate.py` (EnergyPlus 24.2 needed;
`--keep-runs DIR` keeps the full run directories, `--no-simulate` rewrites only the IDFs).

| Fixture | Zones (multiplier) | HVAC and features |
|---|---|---|
| `three_zone` | `Core` (spaces `Core_West_Space`, `Core_East_Space`), `North_Perimeter`, `South_Perimeter` | Space types `Office` (north, core) and `Conference` (south); PTAC per zone (on/off fan, DX cooling, gas heating); `InternalMass` in the core |
| `ten_zone_multipliers` | `Basement`, `G_Perimeter`, `G_Core`, `G_Plenum`, `Typical_Perimeter` (10), `Typical_Core` (5 × zone-group 2), `Typical_Plenum` (5 × 2), `Top_Perimeter`, `Top_Core`, `Attic` | VAV air loop (supply fan, plate heat recovery, differential dry-bulb economiser by heat-exchanger bypass, chilled water from an air-cooled chiller, hot-water reheat from a gas boiler), return plenums on the ground and typical floors; PTHP on the top floor (heat-pump coil); gas water heater with one `WaterUse:Equipment` in `Typical_Core` and one with no zone |
| `ten_zone_explicit` | as above with `T01_*` … `T10_*` drawn (37 zones) | the same building; floors/ceilings that are adiabatic in the multiplied model are interzone here |
| `bar_building` | `North_Perimeter`, `South_Perimeter` | ideal loads; `Daylighting:Controls` in both zones; `Exterior:Lights` (2 kW, astronomical clock) |

### EnergyPlus behaviour the fixtures expose

- Some outputs already include the zone multipliers, others do not. For a multiplied zone,
  `Zone Mechanical Ventilation Standard Density Volume Flow Rate` and the
  `Water Use Equipment Hot Water Volume` of a `WaterUse:Equipment` with a zone include
  `Multiplier × ListMultiplier`. `Zone Air System Sensible Heating/Cooling Energy` does
  not: it is for one copy of the zone. (Checked by comparing the two ten-zone fixtures.)
  HVAC equipment outputs (`Heating Coil Heating Energy` of a terminal's reheat coil, and, in
  a one-off run with a zone multiplier of 2, a PTAC's coils and `Zone Ideal Loads Supply Air
  Total Heating/Cooling Energy`) cover every copy: the equipment meets all copies' load.
- Return plenums report non-zero `Zone Air System Sensible Heating/Cooling Energy` (the
  return air passing through them), although they have no thermostat or equipment.
- Envelope areas, floor areas and hot-water volume agree between `ten_zone_multipliers`
  and `ten_zone_explicit` (exactly, or within 0.003 %). Total outdoor air agrees within
  0.03 %. Delivered and consumed energy differ by 0.1–3.5 %, because of the adiabatic
  surfaces and the floor heights.

### Warnings (no severe errors)

`three_zone`: 1 (a DX coil frost notice, once). `ten_zone_multipliers`: 4, and
`ten_zone_explicit`: 6. These are an air-cooled chiller running below 0 °C outdoors (the
core needs cooling in winter) and a few `SimHVAC` iteration-limit notices.
`bar_building`: 0.
